ideas.title: Uncovering the extent of Minnesota's Medicaid fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the $11 million Medicaid fraud scheme and potential connections to other entities or individuals
ideas.angle: Follow the money and explore connections between entities
questions: What is the scope of the scheme?
ideas.insight: The large sum of money involved and the suspect's disappearance suggest a potentially large-scale fraud scheme that warrants further investigation.
